name: ibis Bandung Pasteur
short_description: A 3-star ibis in Bandung's Pasteur area near the Jakarta toll gate, with an ALL Rating of 4.5/5 from 450 reviews.
ai_summary: ibis Bandung Pasteur (Accor code 9397) is a 3-star economy ibis in the Pasteur area of Bandung, close to the Pasteur toll gate which is the main entry point for visitors driving from Jakarta. This makes it the most convenient Bandung Accor property for road travellers arriving from the capital. The hotel holds an ALL Rating of 4.5/5 from 450 reviews. As an ibis, it offers clean, functional rooms, a restaurant, and free Wi-Fi. For ALL elite members, standard ibis benefits apply.
